label: Photo Album
depicts: Photo album cover with one top binding strip above one mountain picture panel
use_when: Use when the interface wants a bound album cover capped by a short strip above the image panel.
avoid_when: Do not use for the stacked photo album when a second back sheet should sit behind the front panel.

label: Pic
depicts: Picture frame with one sun dot above two mountain peaks inside
use_when: Use when the interface wants a picture frame showing two mountain peaks and one sun dot.
avoid_when: Do not use for the simpler picture frame when only one main peak should dominate the image panel.

label: Pic
depicts: Picture frame with one sun dot above one main mountain peak inside
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simpler picture frame with one dominant mountain peak.
avoid_when: Do not use for the two peak picture when the inner landscape should split into two mountains.

label: Pin
depicts: Folded pushpin flag with one diagonal shaft crossing the lower left side
use_when: Use when the interface wants a folded or flag like pushpin shape crossed by a diagonal shaft.
avoid_when: Do not use for the bell pushpin when the top should widen into a bell cap above a straight stem.

label: Pin
depicts: Bell pushpin cap above one straight centered stem below
use_when: Use when the interface wants a classic pushpin with a bell cap and a straight stem below.
avoid_when: Do not use for the folded pushpin when the shaft should cross diagonally through a flag shape.
